rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: All units have launched! We've caught BG on sensors!
rows.display_text:
「All units have launched! We've caught
BG on sensors!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: So that's BG... the Black Gale...!
rows.display_text: 「So that's BG... the Black Gale...!」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: What'll it be, Captain? Should we move in?
rows.display_text:
「What'll it be, Captain? Should we move
in?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Capture is the priority objective. First, I'll try hailing them on an open channel.
rows.display_text:
「Capture is the priority objective. First,
I'll try hailing them on an open channel.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Black machine, and your escort -- can you hear me? This is the New Earth Federation Forces.
rows.display_text:
「Black machine, and your escort -- can
you hear me? This is the New Earth
Federation Forces.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: We're acting under orders to capture you. I strongly advise you disarm and surrender peacefully.
rows.display_text:
「We're acting under orders to capture
you. I advise you disarm and surrender
peacefully.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Be warned, if you refuse this advisory, we will move to attack.
rows.display_text:
「Be warned, if you refuse this advisory,
we will move to attack.」

rows.speaker: Ziene
rows.en: ...That's what he's saying. What do you want to do?
rows.display_text:
「...That's what he's saying. What do you
want to do?」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: Capture me, huh. Even as a joke, that's in poor taste.
rows.display_text:
「Capture me, huh. Even as a joke, that's
in poor taste.」

rows.speaker: Ziene
rows.en: They're the unit that man had organized. Shall we humor them with a match, as you wished?
rows.display_text:
「They're the unit that man had
organized. Shall we humor them with a
match, as you wished?」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: The time isn't ripe yet. ...Ah, right on cue, guests are arriving. Let's leave them to deal with it.
rows.display_text:
「The time isn't ripe. ...Ah, right on cue,
guests are arriving. Let's leave them to
deal with it.」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: That guy... is he trying to ignore us?
rows.display_text: 「That guy... is he trying to ignore us?」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: If they won't surrender, let's just wrap this up already!
rows.display_text:
「If they won't surrender, let's just
wrap this up already!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Wait! Something's off with the area around us!
rows.display_text:
「Wait! Something's off with the area
around us!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: All units, stay alert! We've confirmed a distortion in the dimensional boundary!
rows.display_text:
「All units, stay alert! We've confirmed a
distortion in the dimensional boundary!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Is a dimensional quake about to hit!?
rows.display_text: 「Is a dimensional quake about to hit!?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: What is with those things! They're creepy!
rows.display_text:
「What is with those things! They're
creepy!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Calm down, Anemone! Those are Shadow Angels -- the enemy of all mankind!
rows.display_text:
「Calm down, Anemone! Those are Shadow
Angels -- the enemy of all mankind!」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: Fallen wings, imprisoned in a cage of cause and effect... Have you come seeking me, who bears the same curse?
rows.display_text:
「Fallen wings, caged by cause and
effect... Have you come seeking me, who
bears the same curse?」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: But I'm still going... I don't need any more chains than I already carry.
rows.display_text:
「But I'm still going... I don't need any
more chains than I already carry.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Fast...! What is that speed!?
rows.display_text: 「Fast...! What is that speed!?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Target has broken away outside combat range. Do we pursue, Captain?
rows.display_text:
「Target has broken away outside combat
range. Do we pursue, Captain?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: No... we'll deal with the Shadow Angels.
rows.display_text: 「No... we'll deal with the Shadow Angels.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: But, our mission is...!
rows.display_text: 「But, our mission is...!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: The mission can wait. But if we leave the Shadow Angels alone, the damage will spread to the surrounding area.
rows.display_text:
「The mission can wait. But leaving the
Shadow Angels alone would let the damage
spread to the area.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Adjust priorities to match the situation...! New attack target: the Shadow Angels!
rows.display_text:
「Adjust priorities to match the
situation...! New attack target: the
Shadow Angels!」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Roger!
rows.display_text: 「Roger!」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Taking down BG here would be no fun anyway. I'll save that treat for later.
rows.display_text:
「Taking down BG here would be no fun
anyway. I'll save that treat for later.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Everyone, be careful. That monster's toughness is no joke. Focus fire and take them down one at a time.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, be careful. That monster's
toughness is no joke. Focus fire, take
them down one at a time.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: It's pulled back...?
rows.display_text: 「It's pulled back...?」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Guess it got scared of us and ran, huh?
rows.display_text:
「Guess it got scared of us and ran,
huh?」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: That's not it...! Another enemy's coming!
rows.display_text:
「That's not it...! Another enemy's
coming!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Confirmed the Shadow Angels have been completely wiped out.
rows.display_text:
「Confirmed the Shadow Angels have been
completely wiped out.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Piece of cake. The special duty force isn't just for show.
rows.display_text:
「Piece of cake. The special duty force
isn't just for show.」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Don't get carried away, Auel...! Another enemy's coming!
rows.display_text:
「Don't get carried away, Auel...! Another
enemy's coming!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Those horns...! The Hyakki Empire!
rows.display_text: 「Those horns...! The Hyakki Empire!」

rows.speaker: Hyakki Hundred
rows.en: The Shadow Angels have already withdrawn...! At this rate we can't gather their data!
rows.display_text:
「The Shadow Angels already withdrew...!
At this rate, we can't gather their data!」

rows.speaker: Hyakki Hundred
rows.en: Out of spite, then! We'll crush the human army instead!
rows.display_text:
「Out of spite, then! We'll crush the
human army instead!」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: It appears the Hyakki Empire is about to attack us.
rows.display_text:
「It appears the Hyakki Empire is about
to attack us.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Tch! We're outnumbered by way too much!
rows.display_text:
「Tch! We're outnumbered by way too
much!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: No need to worry.
rows.display_text: 「No need to worry.」

rows.speaker: Hyakki Hundred
rows.en: Guoh! Where'd that shot come from!?
rows.display_text: 「Guoh! Where'd that shot come from!?」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Can you hear my voice, Colonel Neo Roanoke?
rows.display_text:
「Can you hear my voice, Colonel Neo
Roanoke?」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: At the New Federation's request, we of the Siberian Railway Guard will be joining you as well.
rows.display_text:
「At the New Federation's request, we of
the Siberian Railway Guard will join you
too.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Understood. Perfect timing.
rows.display_text: 「Understood. Perfect timing.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Siberian Railway -- that's the railroad company laying track all over the world, right?
rows.display_text:
「Siberian Railway -- that's the railroad
company laying track all over the world,
right?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: So then, those people are...
rows.display_text: 「So then, those people are...」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: The civilian collaborators the captain mentioned, huh.
rows.display_text:
「The civilian collaborators the captain
mentioned, huh.」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Chased out of Saint Regan, picked up by Sibe Rail, and now enlisted into the Federation's special duty force...
rows.display_text:
（Chased from Saint Regan, picked up by
Sibe Rail, and now enlisted in the
Federation's special duty force...）

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Sticking with the captain just keeps rolling me further and further...
rows.display_text:
（Sticking with the captain just keeps
rolling me further and further...）

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Asuham Boone. So you're the one taking on that demon.
rows.display_text:
「Asuham Boone. So you're the one taking
on that demon.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Getting to battle a legendary monster from Yapan -- what luck.
rows.display_text:
「Getting to battle a legendary monster
from Yapan -- what luck.」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: ...I tagged along with boss Asuham for that special bonus, but I've got a feeling this was a mistake.
rows.display_text:
「...I tagged along with boss Asuham for
the bonus, but I've got a feeling this
was a mistake.」

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: Guess we were just born under that kind of star.
rows.display_text:
「Guess we were just born under that
kind of star.」

rows.speaker: Jaboli
rows.en: If I'd known it'd come to this, I should've just stayed doing odd jobs at head office...!
rows.display_text:
「If I'd known it'd come to this, I
should've just stayed doing odd jobs at
head office...!」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: Hmph... nothing but complaints. What small-minded lot.
rows.display_text:
「Hmph... nothing but complaints. What
small-minded lot.」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: If we make our mark here, we might just get taken on as members of the New Federation, you know.
rows.display_text:
「If we make our mark here, we might get
taken on as members of the New
Federation, you know.」

rows.speaker: Geraba
rows.en: Let's do it, boss! Our road to the top starts right here!
rows.display_text:
「Let's do it, boss! Our road to the top
starts right here!」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Always so positive, that droopy-eyed guy...
rows.display_text:
（Always so positive, that droopy-eyed
guy...）

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Well... after Siberia fell through, all we can do for now is dance to the chairman's tune.
rows.display_text:
（Well... after Siberia fell through, all we
can do for now is dance to the
chairman's tune.）

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Colonel Neo Roanoke. These are Shagia Frost and Olba Frost, of intelligence.
rows.display_text:
「Colonel Neo Roanoke. These are Shagia
Frost and Olba Frost, of intelligence.」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: We'll be providing support the moment we join the Special Task Force 013.
rows.display_text:
「We'll be providing support the moment
we join the Special Task Force 013.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: So you're the military's agents. Good to have you.
rows.display_text:
「So you're the military's agents. Good to
have you.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Thank you for the escort this far, Frost brothers.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you for the escort this far,
Frost brothers.」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: No thanks needed. Starting today, we're all comrades.
rows.display_text:
「No thanks needed. Starting today, we're
all comrades.」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: I'll get to see for myself the strength of Captain Asuham Boone of Saint Regan, the one I've heard so much about.
rows.display_text:
「I'll see for myself the strength of
Captain Asuham Boone of Saint Regan, the
one I've heard so much about.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: The man I am now has thrown away everything from his past, all for the sake of revenge...!
rows.display_text:
「The man I am now has thrown away
everything from his past, all for the sake
of revenge...!」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Let's go, you demons! My resolve will make even the damned of hell tremble!
rows.display_text:
「Let's go, you demons! My resolve will
make even the damned of hell tremble!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Ahahahaha! Let's do our best, Asuham!
rows.display_text: 「Ahahahaha! Let's do our best, Asuham!」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Looks like that's settled.
rows.display_text: 「Looks like that's settled.」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Yeah, but we lost BG completely in all this.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah, but we lost BG completely in all
this.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: We can pick that back up later.
rows.display_text: 「We can pick that back up later.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: First, let's join up with our new allies. All units, land on the carrier.
rows.display_text:
「First, let's join up with our new allies.
All units, land on the carrier.」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Understood.
rows.display_text: 「Understood.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: The Frost brothers from intelligence... Colonel Dewey told me to keep an eye on them.
rows.display_text:
（The Frost brothers from intelligence...
Colonel Dewey told me to keep an eye on
them.）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: If people like that are being called in too, then this special duty force... I should assume there's something behind its formation after all...
rows.display_text:
（If people like that are being called in
too, there's likely more behind this unit's
formation than it seems...）

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Don't forget, Olba. What we're here to do.
rows.display_text:
（Don't forget, Olba. What we're here to
do.）

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: I know, brother. For a unit meant to chase an unidentified target, this lineup is far too unnatural.
rows.display_text:
（I know, brother. For a unit chasing an
unidentified target, this lineup's far too
unnatural.）

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Being sent to a unit like this... maybe it's because someone's caught on to our true purpose.
rows.display_text:
（Being sent to a unit like this... maybe
someone's caught on to our true purpose.）

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: But still, we can't afford to stop.
rows.display_text: （But still, we can't afford to stop.）

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: That's right... Until we've taken our revenge on this whole world and its fate, our fight isn't over.
rows.display_text:
（That's right... Our fight isn't over till
we've taken revenge on this whole world
and its fate.）

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: This is an operation I only joined out of obligation to Kizz Munt...!
rows.display_text:
「This is an operation I only joined out
of obligation to Kizz Munt...!」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Let's wrap this up fast, and get moving on taking down Gain Bijou!
rows.display_text:
「Let's wrap this up fast, and get moving
on taking down Gain Bijou!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Even in a situation like this, his hatred for the Black Southern Cross hasn't changed one bit. That's some serious obsession.
rows.display_text:
（Even in times like these, his hatred for
the Black Southern Cross hasn't changed.
Serious obsession.）

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Ahaha! Let's rack up some experience here, so I can go challenge the King!
rows.display_text:
「Ahaha! Let's rack up some experience
here, so I can go challenge the King!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Now then... Mr. Demon! You're going to keep me company!
rows.display_text:
「Now then... Mr. Demon! You're going to
keep me company!」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: Well, since it's come to this, screw it! I'm surviving this and getting promoted, no matter what!
rows.display_text:
「Well, since it's come to this, screw it!
I'll survive and get promoted, no matter
what!」

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: If we make it back to Sibe Rail alive, there's a special bonus waiting! ...At least, I want to believe that!
rows.display_text:
「If we get back to Sibe Rail alive,
there's a bonus waiting! ...At least, I
want to believe that!」

rows.speaker: Jaboli
rows.en: If we make it back, I swear this time I'm filing for a transfer!
rows.display_text:
「If we make it back, I swear this time
I'm filing for a transfer!」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: Let's go, Geraba! Time to show the Federation what we've got!
rows.display_text:
「Let's go, Geraba! Time to show the
Federation what we've got!」

rows.speaker: Geraba
rows.en: Got it, boss! Better safe under a big tree's shade, right!
rows.display_text:
「Got it, boss! Better safe under a big
tree's shade, right!」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Hey, you two. Getting fired up is all well and good, but don't you dare drag me down.
rows.display_text:
「Hey, you two. Getting fired up is all
well and good, but don't you dare drag me
down.」

rows.speaker: Geraba
rows.en: What'd you say!?
rows.display_text: 「What'd you say!?」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Whoa, that's enough chit-chat. The enemy's already bearing down on us.
rows.display_text:
「Whoa, that's enough chit-chat. The
enemy's already bearing down on us.」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: You want to look good in front of the Federation, right? Then you'd better put in the effort.
rows.display_text:
「You want to look good in front of the
Federation, right? Then put in the effort.」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: You don't have to tell me twice! Here we goooo!
rows.display_text:
「You don't have to tell me twice! Here
we goooo!」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Simple guy. Well... at least that secures me a meat shield.
rows.display_text:
（Simple guy. Well... at least that secures
me a meat shield.）

rows.speaker: Dewey
rows.en: ...So the Special Task Force 013 has been set into motion, hm.
rows.display_text:
「...So the Special Task Force 013 has
been set into motion, hm.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Still, it's a strange thing, gathering the elite of every unit just to chase an unidentified target.
rows.display_text:
「Still, it's odd gathering the elite of
every unit just to chase an unidentified
target.」

rows.speaker: Dewey
rows.en: The order came from Lord Djibril, but the mission itself was apparently proposed by someone else.
rows.display_text:
「The order came from Lord Djibril, but
the mission itself was apparently someone
else's idea.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: And who might that be?
rows.display_text: 「And who might that be?」

rows.speaker: Dewey
rows.en: General Edel Bernal.
rows.display_text: 「General Edel Bernal.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Ah, the one rumored to be joining the Council of Sages... I hear she's approached Djibril before too, moving units around in secret.
rows.display_text:
「Ah, the one rumored for the Council of
Sages... I hear she's approached Djibril
before too, moving units in secret.」

rows.speaker: Dewey
rows.en: Djibril's likely trying to solidify LOGOS's faction, if only to push the old guard out.
rows.display_text:
「Djibril's likely trying to solidify
LOGOS's faction, if only to push the old
guard out.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: So he intends to win Edel Bernal over as a card to play toward that end.
rows.display_text:
「So he intends to win Edel Bernal over
as a card to play toward that end.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: But that man alone won't be able to make full use of her, or the power she commands.
rows.display_text:
「But that man alone won't be able to
make full use of her, or the power she
commands.」

rows.speaker: Dewey
rows.en: I agree. ...So, what do we do?
rows.display_text: 「I agree. ...So, what do we do?」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: I'm thinking the same as you, Dewey Novak.
rows.display_text:
「I'm thinking the same as you, Dewey
Novak.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Besides, she's someone who values law and order. I doubt she approves of the New Earth Federation's current state of affairs.
rows.display_text:
「Besides, she values law and order. I
doubt she approves of the New Earth
Federation's current state.」

rows.speaker: Dewey
rows.en: Understood. With her strength behind us, the Crusade's plan gains that much more reality.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. With her strength behind
us, the Crusade's plan gains that much
more reality.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Then it's decided. ...Edel Bernal... let's welcome her as a comrade.
rows.display_text:
「Then it's decided. ...Edel Bernal... let's
welcome her as a comrade.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: All right, Staff Officer Dominic... go ahead with the briefing.
rows.display_text:
「All right, Staff Officer Dominic... go
ahead with the briefing.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: ...Regarding the target, BG, this is all the information we've been given so far.
rows.display_text:
「...Regarding the target, BG, this is all
the information we've been given so far.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Target BG has been confirmed acting alone, or occasionally with a small number of escort units...
rows.display_text:
「Target BG has been confirmed acting
alone, or with a small number of escort
units...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: But its affiliation and the pilot's identity remain unknown.
rows.display_text:
「But its affiliation and the pilot's
identity remain unknown.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: If they've formed a special duty force just to hunt it down, does that mean it's a threat to the New Federation?
rows.display_text:
「If they formed a special duty force
just to hunt it down, is it a threat to
the New Federation?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: There's nothing on that point in either the deployment order or the military database.
rows.display_text:
「There's nothing on that point in either
the deployment order or the military
database.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: So its very reason for existing is classified even from the people out in the field...
rows.display_text:
「So its very reason for existing is
classified even from the people out in
the field...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Even so, hiding even the sighting reports is on another level entirely.
rows.display_text:
「Even so, hiding even the sighting
reports is on another level entirely.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Still, there is one thing that's certain about BG.
rows.display_text:
「Still, there is one thing that's certain
about BG.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: What's that?
rows.display_text: 「What's that?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: That it's dangerous enough to require a team this large just to track it down.
rows.display_text:
「That it's dangerous enough to require a
team this large just to track it down.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: ...That's not exactly a comforting fact.
rows.display_text: 「...That's not exactly a comforting fact.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: I hear Captain Dominic is with intelligence -- can't your contacts turn up anything?
rows.display_text:
「I hear Captain Dominic is with
intelligence -- can't your contacts turn
up anything?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: I'll reach out to some contacts, but I doubt we'll learn much.
rows.display_text:
「I'll reach out to some contacts, but I
doubt we'll learn much.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: A dangerous enemy shrouded in mystery, huh... Orders or not, this is a heavy mission.
rows.display_text:
「A dangerous enemy shrouded in mystery,
huh... Orders or not, this is a heavy
mission.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Well... I can't say whether that's worse or better than dealing with $c.
rows.display_text:
「Well... I can't say whether that's worse
or better than dealing with $c.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: $c... the independent guerrilla organization built around AEUG, ZAFT, and their special machines?
rows.display_text:
「$c... the independent guerrilla group
built around AEUG, ZAFT, and their special
machines?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Apparently, once we finish tracking down BG, this special duty force will shift over to a unit that deals with them.
rows.display_text:
「Apparently, once BG tracking ends, this
special duty force shifts to a unit that
deals with them.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: So if BG isn't caught, does that mean this mission continues indefinitely?
rows.display_text:
「So if BG isn't caught, does that mean
this mission continues indefinitely?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Who knows... That's for the higher-ups to decide.
rows.display_text:
「Who knows... That's for the higher-ups
to decide.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: I hear $c is currently in Japan, fighting some kind of alien intelligent life form.
rows.display_text:
「I hear $c is currently in Japan,
fighting some kind of alien intelligent life
form.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: The Hyakki Empire, huh... Even in a multiverse, I can't believe things like that actually exist.
rows.display_text:
「The Hyakki Empire, huh... Even in a
multiverse, I can't believe things like
that exist.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: That's how things stand. No matter how dangerous BG is, we can't stay assigned to it forever.
rows.display_text:
「That's how things stand. No matter how
dangerous BG is, we can't stay assigned
to it forever.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: We need to wrap this up quickly and move on to the next mission.
rows.display_text:
「We need to wrap this up quickly and
move on to the next mission.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Captain, when will the rest of our members be joining us?
rows.display_text:
「Captain, when will the rest of our
members be joining us?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: For now, I hear the civilian collaborators are being guided our way by a military agent to rendezvous.
rows.display_text:
「For now, I hear the civilian
collaborators are being guided here by a
military agent to rendezvous.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Heh... seems we're shaping up to be just as much a mixed-bag unit as $c.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... seems we're shaping up to be
just as much a mixed-bag unit as $c.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Tracking down an unidentified enemy with this hodgepodge of military and civilian personnel... I really have to wonder what's going through the higher-ups' heads...
rows.display_text:
「Chasing an unidentified enemy with this
military-civilian hodgepodge... I wonder
what the higher-ups are thinking...」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Whoa!
rows.display_text: 「Whoa!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: What's wrong, Kacricon!?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong, Kacricon!?」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Watch out! There's something behind the hangar!
rows.display_text:
「Watch out! There's something behind the
hangar!」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: ...An animal?
rows.display_text: 「...An animal?」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: It doesn't look like it means us any harm, but...
rows.display_text:
「It doesn't look like it means us any
harm, but...」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: It's probably someone's pet. ...Come here, come here.
rows.display_text:
「It's probably someone's pet. ...Come
here, come here.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Heh heh... aren't you cute. Seems used to people.
rows.display_text:
「Heh heh... aren't you cute. Seems used
to people.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: S-stop it, Ensign! It might just bite you out of nowhere!
rows.display_text:
「S-stop it, Ensign! It might just bite
you out of nowhere!」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: ...Something happen? I heard the lieutenant scream...
rows.display_text:
「...Something happen? I heard the
lieutenant scream...」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: What is this thing! It's kind of great!
rows.display_text: 「What is this thing! It's kind of great!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Gulliver! So this is where you were!
rows.display_text: 「Gulliver! So this is where you were!」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Is it your pet?
rows.display_text: 「Is it your pet?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Nope, we're friends! Right, Gulliver?
rows.display_text: 「Nope, we're friends! Right, Gulliver?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Aha...! Look, it's happy!
rows.display_text: 「Aha...! Look, it's happy!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Wh-what's your problem...!?
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what's your problem...!?」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Can I... pet it?
rows.display_text: 「Can I... pet it?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Cute.
rows.display_text: 「Cute.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Sure. Just be gentle, this one's delicate.
rows.display_text:
「Sure. Just be gentle, this one's
delicate.」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Thank you.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you.」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Pretty pathetic, Lieutenant. Screaming over something like an oversized rat.
rows.display_text:
「Pretty pathetic, Lieutenant. Screaming
over something like an oversized rat.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Wait, huh! Isn't that a bear!?
rows.display_text: 「Wait, huh! Isn't that a bear!?」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: That doesn't matter right now...! The problem is having a sloth on a warship in the middle of an operation!
rows.display_text:
「That doesn't matter now...! The problem
is having a sloth on a warship
mid-operation!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Cut her some slack. It's probably Anemone's pet.
rows.display_text:
「Cut her some slack. It's probably
Anemone's pet.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: But still...!
rows.display_text: 「But still...!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: All that matters is getting the job done. That's just how a special duty force works, isn't it?
rows.display_text:
「All that matters is getting the job
done. That's how a special duty force
works, isn't it?」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: What's wrong, Ensign? Something strange about what I said?
rows.display_text:
「What's wrong, Ensign? Something strange
about what I said?」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: It's the same as what happened the other day -- you really are all about ability, aren't you, Lieutenant.
rows.display_text:
「Same as what happened the other day
-- you're really all about ability, aren't
you, Lieutenant.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: It's this kind of world now... I never thought I could get by on the Titans name alone.
rows.display_text:
「It's this kind of world now... I never
thought I could get by on the Titans
name alone.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: And I've learned the hard way what it means not to have the strength to protect what matters.
rows.display_text:
「And I've learned the hard way what it
means to lack the strength to protect
what matters.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: I'm going to get everything by becoming a stronger man... I plan to make the most of this chance I got, being picked for this special duty force.
rows.display_text:
「I'll get everything by growing
stronger... I'll make the most of being
picked for this special duty force.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: That's about the size of it, as far as how I think.
rows.display_text:
「That's about the size of it, as far as
how I think.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Understood, Lieutenant.
rows.display_text: 「Understood, Lieutenant.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: I saw your skill in the last battle, Ensign. You can just call me Jerid.
rows.display_text:
「I saw your skill in the last battle,
Ensign. You can just call me Jerid.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Huh...

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: I'm all about results, Mouar. If I'm going to trust someone to watch my back, I want to deal with them as equals.
rows.display_text:
「I'm all about results, Mouar. If I'm
trusting someone to watch my back, I
want to deal with them as equals.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Understood... Jerid.
rows.display_text: 「Understood... Jerid.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Scramble! Everyone, prepare to launch!
rows.display_text: 「Scramble! Everyone, prepare to launch!」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: What's going on, Captain? Enemy attack...!?
rows.display_text:
「What's going on, Captain? Enemy
attack...!?」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: We've caught BG. Moving into pursuit right away.
rows.display_text:
「We've caught BG. Moving into pursuit
right away.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Finding the target this fast, now that's lucky! Let's go, Mouar!
rows.display_text:
「Finding the target this fast, now
that's lucky! Let's go, Mouar!」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Jerid... I'll hold you to that.
rows.display_text: （Jerid... I'll hold you to that.）

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: You saved us, Shagia Frost. Back-to-back fights with that tough Hyakki Empire were rough, that's for sure.
rows.display_text:
「You saved us, Shagia Frost. Those
back-to-back fights with the Hyakki
Empire were brutal, for sure.」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Glad we made it in time. It wouldn't do the whole army much good if the special duty force got wiped out halfway through its mission.
rows.display_text:
「Glad we made it in time. It'd be bad
for the whole army if the special duty
force got wiped out mid-mission.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Still, I have to say I'm surprised. I'd heard civilian collaborators were joining, but I didn't expect a Breaker among them.
rows.display_text:
「Still, I'm surprised. I'd heard civilian
collaborators were joining, but not that a
Breaker would be among them.」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: As for that, it seems Sibe Rail, as the one providing the manpower, was given a fair amount of discretion.
rows.display_text:
「As for that, Sibe Rail, providing the
manpower, seems to have been given a
fair amount of discretion.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: But with a unit this mixed together, we can't rely on standard military tactics.
rows.display_text:
「But with a unit this mixed together, we
can't rely on standard military tactics.」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: With respect, Captain, $c is made up of an even more varied group of members than we are.
rows.display_text:
「With respect, Captain, $c is made up
of an even more varied group of members
than we are.」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: That may be why... their tactics are so diverse and flexible, and it's earned them plenty of results.
rows.display_text:
「That may be why... their tactics are
diverse and flexible, earning them plenty
of results.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Much as I hate to admit it, that's the truth. Even Sibe Rail's elite guard lost to them, right at Yapan's doorstep.
rows.display_text:
「Much as I hate to admit it, that's
true. Even Sibe Rail's elite guard lost to
them, right at Yapan's doorstep.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Thinking about it that way, I can start to see the point of putting this unit together.
rows.display_text:
「Thinking about it that way, I can start
to see the point of putting this unit
together.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: How do you mean?
rows.display_text: 「How do you mean?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I'd guess the higher-ups are trying to learn from that $c.
rows.display_text:
「I'd guess the higher-ups are trying to
learn from that $c.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: And while they're at it, probably building a unit with the same concept, to study tactics for beating them.
rows.display_text:
「And while at it, probably building a
unit with the same concept, to study
tactics for beating them.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Tracking down an unidentified target while also building a model case for new tactics... it's not an unreasonable idea.
rows.display_text:
「Tracking an unidentified target while
building a model case for new tactics...
not an unreasonable idea.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Just my own guess, is all. ...By the way, Shagia Frost, how's the rest of our members joining up?
rows.display_text:
「Just my own guess. ...By the way,
Shagia Frost, how's the rest of our
members joining up?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I hear there's a pilot being sent from Augusta...
rows.display_text:
「I hear there's a pilot being sent from
Augusta...」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Augusta...? Was there even a base out there?
rows.display_text:
「Augusta...? Was there even a base out
there?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Apparently there's some facility called the Newtype Research Institute.
rows.display_text:
「Apparently there's some facility called
the Newtype Research Institute.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Newtype?
rows.display_text: 「Newtype?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Someone with an extraordinarily heightened sensitivity, beyond the norm... If I had to give a partial definition, that's about how I'd put it.
rows.display_text:
「Someone with extraordinarily heightened
sensitivity beyond the norm -- that's a
partial definition, at least.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: At Augusta, they're researching military applications for people with that kind of ability.
rows.display_text:
「At Augusta, they're researching military
uses for people with that kind of ability.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: What's wrong? Something on your mind?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong? Something on your mind?」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: No... it's nothing.
rows.display_text: 「No... it's nothing.」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: As for that personnel and equipment from Augusta, they're scheduled to join us at McConnell Base, up ahead.
rows.display_text:
「That personnel and equipment from
Augusta are scheduled to join us at
McConnell Base, up ahead.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I see... We'll use that time to sort out what we know about BG as well.
rows.display_text:
「I see... We'll use that time to sort out
what we know about BG as well.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Captain, set course for McConnell. We're going to pick up our new members.
rows.display_text:
「Captain, set course for McConnell. We're
going to pick up our new members.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Understood.
rows.display_text: 「Understood.」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: This is bad, Miss Cynthia. Word is the ship's about to head out any minute.
rows.display_text:
「This is bad, Miss Cynthia. Word is the
ship's about to head out any minute.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: That's fine. If it leaves without me, I'll just catch up in the Dominator.
rows.display_text:
「That's fine. If it leaves without me,
I'll just catch up in the Dominator.」

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: No way...! We're in the Dogozzo! You can't just leave us behind!
rows.display_text:
「No way...! We're in the Dogozzo! You
can't just leave us behind!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Then you two head back to the ship first. I'm going to finish my shopping at the bazaar before I go.
rows.display_text:
「Then you two head back to the ship
first. I'll finish shopping at the bazaar
before I go.」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: Come on, have a heart. We were sent along specifically to be your bodyguards, Miss Cynthia.
rows.display_text:
「Come on, have a heart. We were sent
specifically as your bodyguards, Miss
Cynthia.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Ahahahaha, that's hilarious! Bodyguards, when you're both weaker than me!
rows.display_text:
「Ahahahaha, that's hilarious! Bodyguards,
when you're both weaker than me!」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: D-damn it...! It's true, so I can't even talk back...!
rows.display_text:
（D-damn it...! It's true, so I can't even
talk back...!）

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: That tiny little butt, and that cute little chest you can't even tell is there or not...
rows.display_text:
（That tiny little butt, and that cute
little chest you can't even tell is there
or not...）

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: Ohh, Miss Cynthia... why do you have to be so charming, and so harsh, at the same time...
rows.display_text:
（Ohh, Miss Cynthia... why do you have to
be so charming, and so harsh, at the
same time...）

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Ooh...! That brooch, it's so cute! I think I'll buy it!
rows.display_text:
「Ooh...! That brooch, it's so cute! I
think I'll buy it!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Hey, what's your problem! I was about to buy that!
rows.display_text:
「Hey, what's your problem! I was about
to buy that!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: First come, first served. Too bad for you, being so slow.
rows.display_text:
「First come, first served. Too bad for
you, being so slow.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Huh... you looking to start something with me?
rows.display_text:
「Huh... you looking to start something
with me?」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: That goes for you too...! Bazaar or not, aren't you selling yourself pretty cheap!
rows.display_text:
「That goes for you too...! Bazaar or
not, aren't you selling yourself pretty
cheap!」

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: This is bad, Miss Cynthia! That pink girl over there is a member of the special duty force!
rows.display_text:
「This is bad, Miss Cynthia! That pink
girl over there is a member of the
special duty force!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: So what, you want me to back down for her?
rows.display_text:
「So what, you want me to back down for
her?」

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: It's not that, it's just...
rows.display_text: 「It's not that, it's just...」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Aren't you two supposed to be my bodyguards! Then go push that girl out of the way and buy me that brooch!
rows.display_text:
「Aren't you two my bodyguards! Then
push that girl aside and buy me that
brooch!」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: Are you serious!?
rows.display_text: 「Are you serious!?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: What do you think you're doing, Anemone? It's already time to assemble.
rows.display_text:
「What do you think you're doing,
Anemone? It's already time to assemble.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Perfect timing, Dominic. Go beat up that girl's bodyguards and buy me that brooch.
rows.display_text:
「Perfect timing, Dominic. Go beat up
that girl's bodyguards and buy me that
brooch.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Wh-why me!?
rows.display_text: 「Wh-why me!?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Fine! If you won't do it, I'll take those two down myself!
rows.display_text:
「Fine! If you won't do it, I'll take
those two down myself!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: N-no, wait!
rows.display_text: 「N-no, wait!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Hurry up, Kejinan, Enge!
rows.display_text: 「Hurry up, Kejinan, Enge!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Dominic! Can't you just do what I say for once!?
rows.display_text:
「Dominic! Can't you just do what I say
for once!?」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Finally found you... You two... playtime's over.
rows.display_text:
「Finally found you... You two...
playtime's over.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: All right, let's get going. Both of you, back to the ship...
rows.display_text:
「All right, let's get going. Both of you,
back to the ship...」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Be quiet, you!
rows.display_text: 「Be quiet, you!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Don't get in the way of a girl's shopping!
rows.display_text:
「Don't get in the way of a girl's
shopping!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Uh... um, well...
rows.display_text: 「Uh... um, well...」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Forget it! Dominic, let's go back!
rows.display_text: 「Forget it! Dominic, let's go back!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Ahh... what a buzzkill. Let's head back, Kejinan, Enge.
rows.display_text:
「Ahh... what a buzzkill. Let's head back,
Kejinan, Enge.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: U-um... well...
rows.display_text: 「U-um... well...」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: Tough break, boss. Guess the timing was just bad.
rows.display_text:
「Tough break, boss. Guess the timing was
just bad.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Thank you, Captain. Somehow that settled things down.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, Captain. Somehow that
settled things down.」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: Well then... we'll head back first.
rows.display_text: 「Well then... we'll head back first.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Heh... what a rotten hand you drew there, Lowen.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... what a rotten hand you drew
there, Lowen.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: E-even if she's just a girl, she's still a woman... Terrifying...
rows.display_text:
「E-even if she's just a girl, she's still
a woman... Terrifying...」
